briefing: New York Mayor Zohran Mamdani unveiled a plan to close Rikers Island by 2032, and the FBI is reportedly investigating an apparent hack of its criminal database. An Anthropic staffer claims he and Claude found a proof of the Riemann Hypothesis, though the claim has yet to be verified. In business, an Ohio steel mill dropped a plan to cut coal use, and the ICE detention of a Princeton researcher worried international scholars. In Idaho, health officials want a 13% raise for disability caregivers.
